stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Fury activates the Avengers Initiative and brings Thor in to stop Loki. Aboard the Helicarrier he asks Thor to get Loki to talk, and they clash when Fury admits S.H.I.E.L.D. is building weapons because of the threat from Asgard.
stages.whoA: The Asgardian he brings into the Avengers to stop Loki.
stages.whoB: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director who brings him into the Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam meets Fury at a hidden S.H.I.E.L.D. base after Fury fakes his death, and Fury leads their plan to stop Project Insight. As the Triskelion falls, Sam leaps from a window into the helicopter Fury is flying. Fury then invites him to hunt HYDRA in Europe, but Sam stays with Steve.
stages.whoA: Falcon, who helps him stop Project Insight.
stages.whoB: The hidden director who leads the fight on Insight and pulls him to safety.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol arrives at the Avengers Compound after the Snap and joins the team. When Bruce asks how a new attack on Thanos could end any differently, she reminds him they did not have her then, and they go after Thanos together.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel, who joins the Avengers to go after Thanos.
stages.whoB: A fellow Avenger who doubts the attack on Thanos until she joins.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Years later Bruce and Carol join Wong to study the Ten Rings with Shang-Chi and Katy.
stages.whoA: A fellow Avenger who studies the Ten Rings with him.
stages.whoB: A fellow Avenger who studies the Ten Rings with her.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Wanda and Clint pick up Scott in Germany to join Steve against the Sokovia Accords. They fight side by side at the Leipzig airport and are locked up together on the Raft.
stages.whoA: Ant-Man, who joins Steve's side. They are locked up on the Raft together.
stages.whoB: A teammate on Steve's side, locked up with him on the Raft.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Strange keeps Loki on a watchlist of threats to Earth. When Thor brings Loki to New York, Strange drops Loki through a portal, offers Thor a drink in the Sanctum, and helps him find Odin so the brothers will leave Earth.
stages.whoA: The sorcerer who helps him find Odin to get Loki off Earth.
stages.whoB: The god of thunder he helps find Odin, to get Loki off Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: The Guardians pull Thor from the wreck of his ship, and Gamora tells him she is the adopted daughter of Thanos. She explains that Thanos means to use the Infinity Stones to wipe out half of all life.
stages.whoA: Thanos' adopted daughter, who warns him what the Stones are for.
stages.whoB: The Asgardian the Guardians rescue, who brings word of Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos' army invades Wakanda for the Mind Stone, and T'Challa leads his people against it. When T'Challa charges him, Thanos grabs him by the throat and slams him to the ground, and T'Challa turns to dust when Thanos snaps.
stages.whoA: The Titan who invades Wakanda and turns him to dust.
stages.whoB: The king of Wakanda, who stands in his way.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: When Elena comes to the Playground and is asked to sign the Sokovia Accords, she shows off her speed by stealing the medals off General Talbot's uniform. She then works with Talbot and Coulson to stop Hive.
stages.whoA: The general who wants her on the Accords. She steals his medals.
stages.whoB: The speedster who steals the medals off his uniform.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: During the siege of the Lighthouse, Elena leads a handcuffed Talbot to safety, and he greets her as Speedy. After the gravitonium makes him Graviton, he turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. and drives her and Mack off at his own home.
stages.whoA: The general who calls her Speedy, then turns on them as Graviton.
stages.whoB: The agent he calls Speedy, whom he turns on as Graviton.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Steve brings Vision to Wakanda so Shuri can try to remove the Mind Stone without killing him. While she works in her lab, Steve leads the fight against Thanos' army outside.
stages.whoA: T'Challa's sister, who tries to remove the Mind Stone from Vision.
stages.whoB: Captain America, who brings Vision to her lab.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: After the world learns Peter is Spider-Man, Wong greets him at the Sanctum. Wong warns that the memory spell Strange offers Peter is too dangerous, but reluctantly agrees before leaving for Kamar-Taj.
stages.whoA: Strange's friend, who warns against the memory spell.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whose memory spell he warns against.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Madame Gao is one of the leaders of the Hand. Luke and the other Defenders fight her people at the Royal Dragon and face her again beneath Midland Circle.
stages.whoA: A leader of the Hand he fights with the Defenders.
stages.whoB: One of the Defenders who fight the Hand.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Inside the Framework, Mace is the Patriot, hiding Inhumans from HYDRA, and Ward fights for the same resistance. Ward brings Coulson and Simmons to him for protection and tells him when Skye is captured.
stages.whoA: A resistance fighter in the Framework who brings him Coulson and Simmons.
stages.whoB: The Patriot, who hides Inhumans from HYDRA in the Framework.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Bakuto is one of the leaders of the Hand. Jessica and the Defenders fight him in the garage beneath Midland Circle on their way to save Danny.
stages.whoA: A Hand leader she fights beneath Midland Circle.
stages.whoB: One of the Defenders who storm Midland Circle.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Rhodey and Clint celebrate with the Avengers at Avengers Tower, where both fail to lift Thor's hammer. They later fight Ultron's army in Sokovia.
stages.whoA: Hawkeye, a fellow Avenger who fights Ultron beside him.
stages.whoB: War Machine, who fights Ultron beside him.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: The Sokovia Accords split them. Rhodey sides with Tony, and at the Leipzig airport he fires on Clint, who sides with Steve.
stages.whoA: A teammate on Steve's side of the Accords, whom he fires on.
stages.whoB: A teammate on Tony's side, who fires on him at the airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Rhodey tracks Clint's trail of killings as Ronin for Natasha. Once Clint comes back to the team, they set out together on the time heist.
stages.whoA: A fellow Avenger back from his Ronin years, on the heist with him.
stages.whoB: The friend who tracks his Ronin killings, then joins the heist with him.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Carol arrives at the Avengers Compound looking for Fury and joins the team. Rhodey asks if she can find Thanos, and they go after him together. Over the next five years they keep working together, checking in by hologram.
stages.whoA: Captain Marvel, who joins the Avengers to go after Thanos.
stages.whoB: War Machine, a fellow Avenger in the hunt for Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Rhodey fights Thanos' army in Wakanda and unloads his whole arsenal on Thanos, who blocks every shot and crushes his armor.
stages.whoA: The Titan who crushes his armor in Wakanda.
stages.whoB: War Machine, who fires everything he has at him in Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Rhodey helps pin Thanos down in the Garden. He fights him again when a Thanos from the past attacks the Avengers Compound.
stages.whoA: The Titan he pins down in the Garden, then fights again.
stages.whoB: An Avenger who pins him down in the Garden, then fights him again.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When the Guardians find Thor floating in space, Mantis senses how much pain he is in and uses her powers to wake him.
stages.whoA: The Guardian who wakes him with her powers.
stages.whoB: The Asgardian she wakes, sensing his pain.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Thor travels with the Guardians, and Mantis and Quill ask him to help fight Habooska's army on Indigarr. He says goodbye to her when the Guardians fly off without him.
stages.whoA: A Guardian he travels with, until they part ways.
stages.whoB: The god who travels with the Guardians for a while.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: After the fight at the Presidential Hotel, Mahoney storms the Fisks' penthouse and arrests Vanessa along with Fisk for their crimes.
stages.whoA: Fisk's wife, whom he arrests along with Fisk.
stages.whoB: The detective who arrests her and Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell's AVTF hunts Bullseye and plans to have a fake Bullseye shoot Matt outside the courthouse. The real Bullseye takes over the rifle and fires at Fisk instead, and Powell and North open fire on him.
stages.whoA: The AVTF officer whose fake Bullseye plot he hijacks.
stages.whoB: The real Bullseye, who hijacks his sniper plot.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Elektra hides and listens when Karen visits Matt one night. Later Karen comes to Matt's apartment and is shocked to find Elektra in his bed.
stages.whoA: The woman she finds in Matt's bed.
stages.whoB: Matt's girlfriend, who finds her in his bed.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: As Ego's planet falls apart, Kraglin flies in to pick up the Guardians, and Drax lifts Mantis up to the ship. Both end up on the team afterward.
stages.whoA: The empath he helps pull off Ego's planet.
stages.whoB: The Ravager who flies in to save them from Ego.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: On Knowhere, Kraglin tells Mantis how Yondu ruined Quill's childhood Christmas. The story moves her to give Quill a real Christmas.
stages.whoA: A fellow Guardian he tells about Yondu and Christmas.
stages.whoB: A fellow Guardian whose Yondu story inspires her Christmas plan.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Claire meets Jessica's neighbor Malcolm while watching over a wounded Luke. They talk about always running toward people who need help, and he offers to sit with Luke so she can rest.
stages.whoA: Jessica's neighbor, who sits with Luke so she can rest.
stages.whoB: A nurse he meets while she watches over Luke.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Sif comes to Earth with the Warriors Three to find Thor and meets Jane. Jane helps clear the town as Sif fights the Destroyer.
stages.whoA: Thor's warrior friend, who comes to Earth to find him.
stages.whoB: The mortal scientist Thor befriends on Earth.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Sif is quietly jealous of Thor's love for Jane, and the two trade cold looks in Asgard. Still, Sif breaks Jane out of her chambers as part of Thor's plan to stop Malekith.
stages.whoA: Thor's old friend, jealous of her, who still helps her escape.
stages.whoB: Thor's love, whom she envies but helps escape.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ayo guards the royal family at T'Challa's coronation and points her spear at M'Baku when he steps menacingly toward Shuri, before he challenges T'Challa for the throne.
stages.whoA: The Jabari leader she holds at spear point at the coronation.
stages.whoB: A Dora Milaje who points her spear at him at the coronation.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: After T'Challa's death, both stand with Queen Ramonda as Wakanda faces Namor. When the Talokanil attack the Wakandan ship, they fight side by side.
stages.whoA: A Wakandan leader she fights beside against the Talokanil.
stages.whoB: A Dora Milaje he fights beside against the Talokanil.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Happy finds Peter's friends in London through Flash's videos and leads them to cover in the Tower of London as Mysterio's drones attack.
stages.whoA: One of Peter's classmates he gets to safety in London.
stages.whoB: Peter's ally, who gets her to safety in London.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: North is the AVTF sergeant who murdered Angela's uncle Hector, the White Tiger. He fires on her and Karen during the Red Hook prison break, and when Angela confronts the AVTF over Hector's death, North starts to doubt what Powell told him.
stages.whoA: The AVTF sergeant who murdered her uncle Hector.
stages.whoB: White Tiger's niece, who confronts him over Hector's death.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Korg is a fellow gladiator on Sakaar, where Hulk is the Grandmaster's champion. He watches Hulk fight Thor in the arena, then fights beside him to save the people of Asgard.
stages.whoA: A fellow gladiator from Sakaar who fights beside him for Asgard.
stages.whoB: Hulk, Sakaar's champion, who fights beside him for Asgard.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later, Korg is living with Thor in New Asgard. He greets Bruce and Rocket when they come for Thor and offers them beer and free Wi-Fi.
stages.whoA: Thor's housemate, who welcomes him to New Asgard.
stages.whoB: Thor's old friend, whom he welcomes to New Asgard.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: During the battle for Asgard, Korg saves Heimdall when Berserkers pin him down. They fight side by side to get Asgard's people onto the Statesman.
stages.whoA: The Kronan who saves his life in the battle for Asgard.
stages.whoB: The Asgardian he saves in the battle for Asgard.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Cosmo joins the Guardians when they make Knowhere their home. She helps Drax and Mantis decorate their base for Christmas to cheer up Quill.
stages.whoA: The Guardians' space dog, who helps him decorate for Christmas.
stages.whoB: A fellow Guardian she helps decorate for Christmas.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Powell insists Soledad's husband Hector was a cop killer. When she and Angela stand up for Hector outside the courthouse, Powell orders North to open fire.
stages.whoA: The AVTF officer who calls her husband a cop killer.
stages.whoB: Hector's widow, who insists her husband never killed anyone.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Peggy fights HYDRA beside Steve's Howling Commandos during the war. After Steve is lost, she leads Dugan and Morita in the raid that captures Werner Reinhardt.
stages.whoA: Steve's unit, who fight HYDRA beside her.
stages.whoB: The SSR agent who fights beside them, then leads them.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: In 1946, Peggy calls in the Howling Commandos to help her and the SSR raid a Leviathan base in Belarus.
stages.whoA: Her old war unit, who help her raid Leviathan.
stages.whoB: Their wartime ally, who calls them in against Leviathan.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Jane meets the Warriors Three when they come to Earth with Sif to find Thor, and she watches them battle the Destroyer.
stages.whoA: Thor's friends, who come to Earth to find him.
stages.whoB: The mortal scientist Thor befriends on Earth.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: When Thor breaks Jane out of Asgard, Volstagg has a ship waiting and Fandral helps them on their way to a secret path out of the realm.
stages.whoA: Volstagg and Fandral, who help her escape Asgard.
stages.whoB: Thor's love, whom they help escape Asgard.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Carol keeps swapping places with Kamala and lands in the Khans' living room. When Kree soldiers attack the house, she fights them off beside Kamala while Aamir tries to shield his parents.
stages.whoA: Kamala's brother, whose family she defends from the Kree.
stages.whoB: Captain Marvel, who pops into his living room and fights off the Kree.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. is the A.I. that runs Tony's mansion and his armor. As Tony's assistant, Pepper deals with him every day.
stages.whoA: Tony's A.I., who runs the house she manages.
stages.whoB: Tony's assistant, who works with him every day.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May meets MJ, Peter's girlfriend, the day Mysterio's video exposes Peter as Spider-Man. When Damage Control brings them in, both tell Peter not to answer anything without a lawyer.
stages.whoA: Peter's girlfriend. They stand by him when his secret is out.
stages.whoB: Peter's aunt. They stand by him when his secret is out.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Betty brings Bruce to Samuel Sterns at Grayburn College, hoping his research can cure him. She helps strap Bruce in for the experiment, then learns Sterns has secretly been growing samples of Bruce's blood.
stages.whoA: Mr. Blue, the scientist she takes Bruce to for a cure.
stages.whoB: Bruce's love, who brings him to Sterns for a cure.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Rocket tells the Ravagers how Yondu gave his life to save Quill. Moved, Stakar and his clan come to honor Yondu at his funeral.
stages.whoA: Yondu's old captain, who comes to honor him at his funeral.
stages.whoB: The Guardian who tells him of Yondu's sacrifice.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Stakar's Ravagers help the Guardians steal the passkey they need to save Rocket's life.
stages.whoA: The Ravager chief who helps save his life.
stages.whoB: The Guardian whose life his Ravagers help save.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Josie throws Cherry's retirement party at her bar. She refuses his money and leads a toast to his health, just before Bullseye attacks the bar.
stages.whoA: A regular whose retirement party she throws at her bar.
stages.whoB: The bar owner who throws his retirement party.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. took over J.A.R.V.I.S.'s work for Tony after his code became part of Vision. Years later both live in the White Vision's Mindspace, where she counts him as a friend.
stages.whoA: The A.I. who took over his work, now a friend in Vision's mind.
stages.whoB: Her predecessor, now a friend in the White Vision's Mindspace.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Marci works at Landman and Zack, the firm Matt and Foggy turned down, and opposes them in Elena Cardenas' case. She later copies files that help them take down Fisk.
stages.whoA: A Landman and Zack lawyer who opposes them, then helps.
stages.whoB: Foggy's partner, whose case she opposes before helping.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Marci is now with Foggy, and Matt knows her as his best friend's girlfriend.
stages.whoA: Foggy's girlfriend.
stages.whoB: Foggy's best friend.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: The White Vision keeps F.R.I.D.A.Y. and other Stark A.I.s inside his Mindspace, where she takes the human form of Allison Hogan, the woman she was modeled on. She becomes a close friend who helps him in his search to understand humanity.
stages.whoA: The White Vision, who keeps her in his Mindspace as a close friend.
stages.whoB: Tony's old A.I., a close friend in his Mindspace.
